summary: Tested universal single-entry PDF endpoint GET /api/print/{kind}/{entry_id} for all 13 kinds + frontend PrintEntryButton integration across all listed pages. Backend: 18 passed / 24 skipped (skipped kinds had no seeded records — expected per main agent note). Unknown kind and unknown id both correctly return 404; unauthenticated request returns 401/403; ?format=json returns {title, subtitle, sections}; ?include_files=true still returns application/pdf. Frontend: login works, every requested page renders without error boundary/white screen. On pages with records the per-entry print icon (data-testid=`print-{kind}-trigger`) renders next to the row actions; clicking the walkaround trigger opens the dropdown with `print-walkaround-print` and `print-walkaround-download` items as required. Pages with zero triggers (Vehicles Service, Repairs, Wheel Security, Compliance Docs, Prohibitions, Fuel) simply have no seeded records for this account and were noted (not failures).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (>6600 lines); consider splitting the /print router into a dedicated module together with entry_reports.py — the endpoint itself is clean and correct.
PrintEntryButton correctly uses responseType blob, revokes object URLs, and shows a spinner while busy — good UX. Menu items have all required data-testid attributes.
Login response returns `token` (not `access_token`). Multiple pytest suites in repo may need alignment; test file now handles both.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 executable; 24 skipped due to empty collections)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all pages render, all required test-ids present where records exist)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing records. Kinds without seed data (service, repair, wheel, recall, prohibition, compliance-doc, fuel) could not be exercised end-to-end; consider seeding one of each in preview DB to fully cover the print grid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_print_entries.py parametrises all 13 kinds and discovers ids via list endpoints. Walkaround list endpoint is /api/walkarounds (plural). Login returns 'token' not 'access_token'. If preview DB gets seed data for service/repair/wheel/recall/prohibition/compliance-doc/fuel, the corresponding parametrised tests will automatically run instead of skipping.
